title: Create an account, verify, sign in and see My bookings
caption: `tools/e2e/specs/storefront/account-bookings.e2e.ts` steps 1-4 (OFE-019).

steps.title: Sign up
steps.body: First and last name, a new e-mail, a password of at least 10 characters that is not common, tick the terms; Create an account.
steps.expect: Signed in at once (the API opens a session for every sign-up), on to `/account/`; header "Hi, <first name>". DB: `customers` (`status = active`, `email_verified_at` empty), `customer_identities`, `customer_sessions`, `customer_consents` (terms, privacy); `notifications` `auth.verify_email` pending → sent.

steps.title: Verify the e-mail
steps.body: Open the verification e-mail in Mailpit and its link `/account/verify.html?token=vt_…`.
steps.expect: The token disappears from the address bar at once; "Confirm your e-mail address" shows success and lists claimed guest bookings, if any. DB: `customers.email_verified_at` set; guest bookings with that `contact_email` get `customer_id`.

steps.title: Sign out and sign in
steps.body: Sign out from the account menu, open **My bookings**: you are sent to sign-in with `next=/bookings.html`; sign in.
steps.expect: Back on `/bookings.html`. Cookies `__Host-vx_at` and `__Host-vx_rt` are httpOnly; `document.cookie` shows only `__Host-vx_csrf`, whose value changed at sign-in.

steps.title: My bookings tabs
steps.expect: Each tab has its own address and `aria-current`; an empty Upcoming offers the search and "Booked as a guest? Find your booking". Cards: route, dates, travellers, reference, total, status word + colour.

steps.title: Account page
steps.body: Change the phone and save; change the password; try a wrong current password.
steps.expect: Only changed fields are sent with `ifMatch`; wrong password = field error on Current password; repeated wrong passwords = "Too many wrong passwords" with the wait (`429` `details.reason: password_attempts`, or `423 ACCOUNT_LOCKED` on the password change) and a reset link.
